description: issue #851: `set_shape "arrow"` - `"arrow"` is one of the four portable shape words that `spec/rendering.md` now requires every implementation to support (MUST, raised from SHOULD), so it is accepted, updates `turtle.shape` from the default `"turtle"`, and emits `shape-change` ({from: "turtle", to: "arrow"}) with no diagnostic. It is also the word the runnable sprite example in `spec/turtles-and-sprites.md` uses, which no fixture asserted before this one.
